Marxism is a political philosophy [ 1 ] and method of socioeconomic analysis that uses a dialectical materialist interpretation of historical development, [ 2 ] known as historical materialism , to understand class relations and social conflict. Originating in the works of 19th-century German philosophers Karl Marx and Friedrich Engels , the Marxist approach views class struggle as the central driving force of historical change.
